options.name: Microsoft OAuth2 (Graph)
options.description: Generic Microsoft Graph credential. Enable the scopes this node needs (e.g. Files.ReadWrite.All) on the credential.

options.name: Microsoft Entra Service Principal (App-Only)
options.description: App-only access via a Microsoft Entra app registration. Choose which user or drive to watch under "Access As".

properties.name: resourceTarget

options.name: User
options.description: Act on a user's OneDrive (by UPN or user ID)

options.name: Drive
options.description: Act on a specific drive (by drive ID)

properties.description: Which drive the Service Principal should act on (app-only has no personal drive)

properties.name: userTarget

modes.name: id
modes.placeholder: e.g. jane@contoso.com or a user object ID
modes.hint: The user principal name (UPN) or object ID of the user whose OneDrive to use

properties.description: The user whose OneDrive the Service Principal should act on. Resolved once per poll.

properties.name: driveTarget

modes.name: id
modes.hint: The drive's own ID (looks like `b!…`), not a file or folder ID. Get it from `GET /users/{upn}/drive` (the `id` field).

properties.description: The drive the Service Principal should act on. Resolved once per poll.

options.name: File Created
options.description: When a new file is created

options.name: File Updated
options.description: When an existing file is modified

options.name: Folder Created
options.description: When a new folder is created

options.name: Folder Updated
options.description: When an existing folder is modified

properties.name: simple
properties.description: Whether to return a simplified version of the response instead of the raw data

properties.name: watchFolder
properties.description: Whether to watch for the created file in a given folder, rather than the entire OneDrive

properties.name: watch
properties.description: How to select which file to watch

options.name: Any File
options.description: Watch for updated files in the entire OneDrive

options.name: Inside a Folder
options.description: Watch for updated files inside a selected folder

options.name: A Selected File
options.description: Watch a specific file for updates

properties.name: watchFolder
properties.description: Whether to watch for the created folder in a given folder, rather than the entire OneDrive

properties.name: watch
properties.description: How to select which folder to watch

options.name: Any Folder
options.description: Watch for updated folders in the entire OneDrive

options.name: Inside a Folder
options.description: Watch for updated folders inside a selected folder

options.name: A Selected Folder
options.description: Watch a specific folder for updates

properties.name: fileId
properties.description: The file to operate on. The 'By URL' option only accepts URLs that start with 'https://onedrive.live.com'.

properties.name: folderId
properties.description: The folder to operate on. The 'By URL' option only accepts URLs that start with 'https://onedrive.live.com'.

properties.name: folderId
properties.description: The folder to operate on. The 'By URL' option only accepts URLs that start with 'https://onedrive.live.com'.

options.name: folderChild
options.description: Whether to look for modified files/folders in all nested folders, rather than only direct descendants

options.name: folderChild
options.description: Whether to look for modified files/folders in all nested folders, rather than only direct descendants
